newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS has no comment on money manager Scudder.
newsitem.headline: UBS has no comment on money manager Scudder.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland SBGZ.S (UBS) declined comment on a report talking about a possible purchase of money manager Scudder Stevens & Clark Inc, but a spokeswoman repeated UBS's stated interest in an acquisition in the U.S.

"We would never comment on such rumours," UBS spokesman Gertrud Erismann said. But she also pointed out that UBS management has said it was interested in an acquisition to shore up its asset management activities in the U.S.
"We are looking for an acquisition in America, but it must be the right company and the right price and be the right cultural fit," Erismann said.

UBS chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta has said on several occasions recently that the bank must establish a greater presence in U.S. asset management in order to remain an important global financial player.
He has also said the bank was potentially interested in an acquisition in private banking.
"I think that when an asset management firm in the U.S. is up for sale UBS is always potentially interested," said Zuercher Kantonalbank banking analyst Christoph Bieri.
But Bieri also said that in his view the price range for Scudder, Stevens & Clark of between $1 billion and $1.5 billion was quite high. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
